Interface RegulatedMotor

All Superinterfaces:
BaseMotor, DCMotor
All Known Implementing Classes:
RcxRegulatedMotor
public interface RegulatedMotor extends DCMotor
A motor with encoder feedback and closed-loop speed/position control.

Speeds and accelerations are expressed in degrees per second and degrees per second squared. Tachometer positions and rotation arguments are expressed in motor-shaft degrees. A rotation with immediateReturn == false waits until the requested motion completes; a rotation with immediateReturn == true starts the motion and returns immediately.

    Methods inherited from interface BaseMotor

    backward, flt, forward, stop
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    void
    backward()
    Turns the motor in reverse until BaseMotor.stop() or BaseMotor.flt() is called.
    void
    flt()
    Removes all power so the motor coasts to a stop, unlike BaseMotor.stop(), which holds it in place.
    void
    forward()
    Turns the motor forward until BaseMotor.stop() or BaseMotor.flt() is called.
    void
    stop()
    Halts the motor at once and resists further movement, unlike BaseMotor.flt(), which lets it coast.
